qualification.worker_stack_tool_source:
#!/usr/bin/env python3
# SPDX-License-Identifier: GPL-3.0-only
"""Exercise a compiled worker with a supplied patch in an emulator-only flash image.

No MIDI device or physical flash is accessed. M1EMU names the stack-aware emulator.
Example: tools/aot_fixture_stack.py BIN ELF PATCH --worker pair --margin 128
"""
import argparse
import binascii
import os
from pathlib import Path
import re
import struct
import subprocess
import tempfile


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument("bin", type=Path)
    parser.add_argument("elf", type=Path)
    parser.add_argument("patch", type=Path)
    parser.add_argument("--worker", choices=("poly", "pair", "oracle"), default="poly")
    parser.add_argument("--margin", type=int, default=0, help="extra bytes kept above the existing 256-byte guard")
    args = parser.parse_args()
    if args.margin < 0:
        parser.error("margin must be nonnegative")
    image = args.bin.resolve()
    emulator = Path(os.environ.get("M1EMU", "tools/emu/target/release/m1emu")).resolve()
    symbols = {}
    for line in subprocess.check_output(["nm", str(args.elf)], text=True).splitlines():
        words = line.split()
        if len(words) == 3:
            symbols[words[2]] = int(words[0], 16)
    # The compiler can inline the voice loop; its envelope setup remains an exclusive kernel entry.
    worker = symbols[{"pair": "aot_pair_worker", "poly": "aot_lane1_job", "oracle": "oracle_env_begin"}[args.worker]]
    names = ("fm1_c1_on", "fm1_c1_gave_up", "c1_pass", "c1_fail", "aot_nx", "transport_on")
    addresses = [symbols[name] for name in names]
    patch = args.patch.read_bytes()
    if not 0 < len(patch) <= 3840:
        parser.error("patch must fit a device slot")
    # slotstore.c: slot 0, sequence 1, header at 0x97000, payload 256 bytes later.
    flash = bytearray(b"\xff" * (1 << 20))
    def record(address, slot, name, data):
        header = struct.pack("<IIIII20sII", 0x3253314D, slot, 1, len(data),
                             binascii.crc_hqx(data, 0xffff), name, 0, 0)
        flash[address:address + len(header)] = header
        flash[address + 256:address + 256 + len(data)] = data
    record(0x97000, 0, b"AOT STACK FIXTURE", patch)
    # Emulator settings only: no quick-start overlay, global tempo 120, analog output on.
    # Matching checkout, as for BIN/ELF: mark the current factory set to avoid unrelated migration work.
    root = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent
    fmt = int(re.search(r"#define ENG_PATCH_VERSION (\d+)", (root / "firmware/src/engine.h").read_text())[1])
    factory = int(re.search(r"#define FACTORY_SET_ID (0x[0-9a-f]+)", (root / "firmware/src/presets.h").read_text())[1], 16)
    settings = bytes((1, 0, 8, 0, 2, 120, 0, 128, 0, 0, fmt, 0, 0)) + factory.to_bytes(3, "little")
    record(0x98000, 64, b"", settings)
    floor = symbols["_c1_ustack"] + 256 + args.margin
    env = dict(os.environ, M1EMU_C1_STACK_LOW=f"{floor:x}", M1EMU_C1_WATCH_PC=f"{worker:x}")
    keys = "5000:PLAY,5200:PLAY^," + ",".join(f"{at}:m90{note:02x}64" for at, notes in
                                  ((6000, (60, 64, 67, 71)), (8000, (72, 76, 79, 83))) for note in notes)
    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="aot-fixture-stack-") as tmp:
        path = Path(tmp) / "flash.bin"
        path.write_bytes(flash)
        run = subprocess.run([str(emulator), "run", str(image), "--flash-in", str(path), "--ms", "10000",
                              "--keys", keys, "--peek", ",".join(f"{a & ~3:x}" for a in addresses)],
                             cwd=tmp, env=env, text=True, stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.STDOUT)
    print(run.stdout, end="")
    run.check_returncode()
    words = {int(a, 16): int(v, 16) for a, v in re.findall(r"peek 0x([0-9a-f]+) = 0x([0-9a-f]+)", run.stdout)}
    byte = lambda a: (words[a & ~3] >> (8 * (a & 3))) & 255
    on, gave, passed, failed, count, transport = addresses
    assert byte(on) == 1 and byte(gave) == 0 and words[passed] > 0 and words[failed] == 0, "core health failed"
    assert byte(count) > 0, "fixture did not bind a compiled assembly"
    assert byte(transport) == 1, "sequencers were not running"
    assert f"core 1 reached watched pc {worker:#010x}" in run.stdout, "requested worker never executed"
    played = re.search(r"(\d+) ms emulated.*audio peak (\d+)", run.stdout)
    assert played and int(played[1]) >= 10000 and int(played[2]) > 0, "played check did not finish"
    print(f"PASS: {args.worker} worker, two healthy cores, stack stayed {args.margin} bytes above its guard")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

"""Run only after explicit rig handoff and matching boot/worker-stack gates."""
import hashlib,json,pathlib,subprocess,sys
root=pathlib.Path('/private/tmp/matryoshka-qualification-fixes')
out=pathlib.Path(__file__).parent
artifact=pathlib.Path(sys.argv[1]).resolve()
tag=sys.argv[2]
py=str(root/'build/venv/bin/python')
meta=json.loads((artifact/'matryoshka.json').read_text())
assert hashlib.sha256((artifact/'matryoshka.fwsc').read_bytes()).hexdigest()==meta['sha256']
flags=meta['build']
assert flags['ENG_AOT']==1 and all(flags[k]==0 for k in ('ENG_AOT_FUSE','ENG_AOT_DRUMS','ENG_AOT_PAIR','ENG_RAMCODE'))
assert flags['FELUCCA_SPEED']=='0'
assert flags['ENG_AOT_ORACLE']==(1 if tag=='integrated' else 0)
meta['fixtures']={}
for voices in (2,3,4):
 p=root/f'build/aot-capacity/oracle-{voices}-ordered-four-tracks.m1p'
 meta['fixtures'][p.name]={'sha256':hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),'hex':p.read_bytes().hex()}
(out/f'{tag}-meta.json').write_text(json.dumps(meta,indent=1)+'\n')
def cmd(args,name,allow_overload=False):
 with (out/f'{tag}-{name}.log').open('w') as log:
  r=subprocess.run(['caffeinate','-i',py,*args],cwd=root,text=True,stdout=log,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT)
 if r.returncode:
  if not allow_overload: r.check_returncode()
  text=(out/f'{tag}-{name}.log').read_text()
  if 'Invalid timing window: overload mute, voice shedding or late audio' not in text: r.check_returncode()
 return (out/f'{tag}-{name}.log').read_text()
def health(name):
 s=cmd(['tools/m1_link.py','--rig','cores'],name)
 assert s.startswith('2 CORES; barred no;') and 'split on' in s and 'failed 0; refused jobs 0;' in s,s
 print(tag,name,s.strip(),flush=True)
health('before-install')
cmd(['tools/fm1_install.py',str(artifact/'matryoshka.fwsc'),'--rig','--yes'],'install')
health('after-install')
for repeat in range(3):
 name=f'oracle-alone-{repeat}'
 cmd(['tools/m1_link.py','--rig','blocktime','5','--patch','Oracle V','--notes','4','--json',str(out/f'{tag}-{name}.json')],name)
 health(name+'-health')
 for voices in (2,3,4):
  name=f'four-track-{voices}-{repeat}'
  cmd(['tools/rig_aot_profile.py',str(root/f'build/aot-capacity/oracle-{voices}-ordered-four-tracks.m1p'),str(out/f'{tag}-{name}.json'),'--hold','5'],name,True)
  health(name+'-health')
  result=json.loads((out/f'{tag}-{name}.json').read_text())
  print(tag,name,'VALID' if result['valid'] else 'OVERLOAD',flush=True)
print(tag,'finished; no hardware commands active',flush=True)
profiling_tool_source:
# SPDX-License-Identifier: GPL-3.0-only
"""Profile a sequenced capacity fixture on the registered rig, after its firmware's emulator gates.

Run with build/venv/bin/python:
  tools/rig_aot_profile.py PATCH.m1p OUT.json [--hold 5]
Starts transport and holds eight notes, waits one second, then captures the block-time window.
Stops transport and releases notes on exit. Does not install firmware or save device settings.
"""
import argparse
import json
import pathlib
import time

import mido
import m1_link as M


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument("patch", type=pathlib.Path)
    parser.add_argument("output", type=pathlib.Path)
    parser.add_argument("--hold", type=float, default=5.0)
    args = parser.parse_args()
    if not 1 <= args.hold <= 60:
        parser.error("--hold must be between 1 and 60 seconds")
    data = args.patch.read_bytes()
    link = M.rig_link()

    def page(n):
        p = link.ask(M.frame(0x2B, [n]), (0x4B, n))
        return [int.from_bytes(bytes(p[1 + 4*i:5 + 4*i]), "little") for i in range((len(p)-1)//4)]

    def health():
        c = page(114)
        if c[0] != 1 or c[3] != 0 or c[4] != 0:
            raise RuntimeError(f"Core fault: stop qualification and preserve diagnostics: {c}")
        return c

    result = {"fixture": args.patch.stem, "notes": M.BT_NOTES, "seconds": args.hold, "before": health()}
    M.upload_chunks(link, data)
    crc = M.crc16(data)
    link.ack(M.frame(0x11, [len(data) & 255, len(data) >> 8, crc & 255, crc >> 8]), 0x11, wait=3)
    guard_before = page(119)
    try:
        link.out.send(mido.Message("start"))
        for note in result["notes"]:
            link.out.send(mido.Message("note_on", note=note, velocity=100))
        time.sleep(1)
        page(132)
        time.sleep(args.hold)
        result["page132"] = page(132)
        spans = []
        for pg in range(133, 138):
            x = page(pg)
            spans.extend((x[2*i], x[2*i+1]) for i in range(4))
        result["spans_ns"] = {M.BT_SPANS[i][0]: {"mean": a, "max": b}
                              for i, (a, b) in enumerate(spans[:len(M.BT_SPANS)])}
        result["page138"] = page(138)
        result["page139"] = page(139)
        result["cpu"] = page(127)
        result["guard"] = page(119)
        result["after"] = health()
        result["valid"] = (result["cpu"][3] == 0 and result["cpu"][7] == 0
                           and result["guard"][2] == guard_before[2])
    finally:
        link.out.send(mido.Message("stop"))
        for note in result["notes"]:
            link.out.send(mido.Message("note_off", note=note))
        args.output.write_text(json.dumps(result, indent=1) + "\n")
    if not result["valid"]:
        raise RuntimeError("Invalid timing window: overload mute, voice shedding or late audio")
    print(f"{args.patch.stem}: valid profile written to {args.output}")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
